LeaderBlueBeforeText:
BLUE: Yo! Finally
got here, huh?

I wasn't in the
mood at CINNABAR,

but now I'm ready
to battle you.

…

You're telling me
you conquered all the GYMS in JOHTO?

Heh! JOHTO's GYMS
must be pretty pathetic then.

Hey, don't worry
about it.

I'll know if you
are good or not by

battling you right
now.

Ready, JOHTO
CHAMP?
LeaderBlueWinText:
BLUE: What?

How the heck did I
lose to you?

…

Tch, all right…
Here, take this-- it's EARTHBADGE.
LeaderBlueAfterText:
BLUE: …

All right, I was
wrong. You're the

real deal. You are
a good trainer.

But I'm going to
beat you someday.

Don't you forget
it!
LeaderBlueEpilogueText:
BLUE: Listen, you.

You'd better not
lose until I beat you. Got it?
ViridianGymGuideText:
Yo, CHAMP in
making!

How's it going?
Looks like you're on a roll.

The GYM LEADER is
a guy who battled

the CHAMPION three
years ago.

He's no pushover.

Give it everything
you've got!
ViridianGymGuideWinText:
Man, you are truly
tough…

That was a heck of
an inspirational

battle. It brought
tears to my eyes.
